state_zip.integrity: Every files[] entry records path + sha256. The request records SHA-256 of the entire uploaded current-state ZIP. Output parent_state_sha256 equals that request hash on a normal run.
state_zip.raw_evidence: Historical raw evidence bytes are not carried in every state ZIP; durable source hashes/names/labels and judgments remain in evidence_ledger.csv.

results_zip.installer_rule: The installer supports updated-state + results, state-only, and results-only installs. Any selected results ZIP must contain results_manifest.json, must not be a portable-state ZIP, and must target the same course/unit as the selected state or the existing local current state.
results_zip.repair_rule: At installer startup, any ZIP already under a Results Archives folder that is positively identified as a portfolio-portable-state/1 ZIP and does not contain results_manifest.json is removed as a misfiled state artifact. Other unknown ZIPs are preserved.
results_zip.report_refresh_only: A valid current portable state may be used to refresh reports with no evidence, roster, or support changes. That run returns Portfolio_Results.zip and does not create or increment Portfolio_State_UPDATED.zip unless longitudinal state actually changes.

migration.normal_runs_after_migration: Drive reads/writes are forbidden unless explicitly requested for backup/recovery.
